messages:
mina: ok team — putting together a short proposal for a "profilespec" (packaged quant profile) format + rollout plan for Redwood Optimize. want opinions on naming, required fields, and compatibility rules. starting sketch below.

jay: loving the "profilespec" term. quick ask: should we force semantic versioning (v1, v2) or use immutable hashes + a compatibility field? :thinking_face:

sophie: prefer hash + compat field. semantic versions get messy when we adjust heuristics. compat makes it explicit: e.g. compat:runtime-v3, kernel-abi-v2.

ryan: also need a clear deploy-time policy for fallback. if profile missing on dedicated/private, should we: 1) fallback to runtime default, 2) reject, or 3) auto-map to nearest compatible profile? my vote = (3) with opt-in.

mina: proposal: id format = "urn:rdo:pspec:<model-family>:<quant-method>:<bits>:<variant>@v<semver>" for human-readable + add immutable sha256 in manifest. e.g. urn:rdo:pspec:gptj:gptq:8:fastdecode@v1 + sha256.

jay: OK but keep a short stable alias for product UI like "rdo://pspec/<short-id>" that maps to the latest compatible SHA. ensures console links don't rot.

opt-bot: reminder: bakeoff tasks require these manifest fields: 
```
id, sha256, model_pattern, quant_backend, quant_bits, method (gptq|awq|int8|fp8), calibration_data, eval_snapshot, metrics:{mmluz, ppl, rouge}, thresholds:{delta_pct, max_ppl_increase}, created_by, created_ts, compat_tags
```

mina: threshold examples — Redwood Optimize defaults: accept if delta_pct <= 1.0 on primary eval (task accuracy) OR ppl increase <= 2.0%. flag if between 1-3% and reject >3%. keep knobs per-customer in Console.

sophie: we should include an "eval-suite-hash" and a human readable "anchor-run" link (S3 or console) so QA can reproduce. also add "quant-params" blob (per-layer config) but store as artifact, not inline.

ryan: rollout plan idea: publish pspec to catalog as "staged" -> autopromote after X traffic/day or N manual approvals. dedicated/private: expose manifest + an import tool that validates compat_tags vs runtime. provide CLI: `rdo-pspec import --validate-only`.

mina: action items: jay will draft spec doc w/ examples, sophie will write validation rules (compat_tag matrix), ryan will wire import CLI and fallback mapping, i'll add default Optimize thresholds and console UX mocks. aim to merge into repo next week. :thumbsup:

opt-bot: bakeoff checklist reminder posted to #eng-ml-bakeoffs: run fp16 baseline, run gptq/awq/int8 variants, collect `eval-suite` JSON, compute deltas, upload pspec manifest and artifacts.

mina: thanks — short thread but useful. i’ll post the initial PR link when ready.
